outputs.name: analyticsGuide
outputs.description: Static Guide for the analytics topic: its summary covers the durable local cross-project loop and Jev usage analytics, and its steps, rules, anti-patterns and example commands give guidance on using it. It is a constant exported for importers that need this guidance; it performs no import, query or recording itself, so its rules are text that this module does not enforce.

examples.summary: Durable local cross-project loop and Jev usage analytics.
steps: Import historical loops from a selected root.
Query summary, loops, jev, models or events.
Supply author and stable task or loop-step identity on Jev checks.
Serve the bundled report website to explore Analytics.
rules: Analytics stay local beyond report media expiry.
Missing historical author and Jev attempt data remain unknown.
Author model is --agent-model or HARNESS_AGENT_MODEL, separate from Jev --model.
First-try rates exclude cached-only, dry-run, incomplete, unlinked and duplicate assessments.
HARNESS_ANALYTICS_HOME overrides the store; HARNESS_ANALYTICS_DISABLED=1 disables recording.
antiPatterns: Do not treat advisory exit zero as a semantic Jev pass.
Do not reuse a task ID for a new task.
exampleCommands: harness response-check --request request.txt --response answer.txt --task answer-1 --agent-model gpt-6.1-sol

outputs.name: reportGuide
outputs.description: Static Guide for the report topic: its summary covers the Project Reports store and the website bundled into Harness, and its steps, rules, anti-patterns and example commands give guidance on using it. It is a constant exported for importers that need this guidance; it performs no report, media or upload action itself, so its rules are text that this module does not enforce.

examples.summary: The Project Reports store and the website bundled into Harness.
steps: Begin a feature or suite report.
Record checks and evidence, including transcripts with audio.
Serve the explorer and analytics locally.
Finalize a report to seal its record.
rules: Existing PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME and manifests remain compatible.
Use PROJECT_REPORTS_CONFIG_FILE and PROJECT_REPORTS_CLOUDFLARE_CONFIG_HOME for project-owned configuration.
Media requires configured private R2 for real reports.
Reports expire after 30 days; analytics history remains.
antiPatterns: Do not publish global analytics automatically.
Do not confuse R2 uploads with website publication.
exampleCommands: harness report begin --project /path/to/project --title Delivery --mode feature --environment local
